title: See Mosquito Bay glow after dark
description: Cross to Vieques and join a permitted evening tour of Mosquito Bay. As the boat moves through dark water, tiny organisms can flash blue-green in its wake, making each ripple seem lit from within. A moonless or low-moon night helps the effect stand out; a seated electric-boat tour is an option if paddling is not appealing.
teaser: Watch bioluminescence shimmer in a Vieques bay.
goodToKnow: Choose a boat outing if you prefer to stay out of the water. A moonless night can make the glow easier to see; confirm boat operation, boarding and life jackets.
whyItMightDelightYou: The glow is brief and responsive to movement, which makes every turn of the boat feel surprising.
